title: Grateful Dead Live at Meramec Community College on 1970-05-14
source: Set 2 Source: Soundboard > Reel Master > DAT (48k)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with speed/tune fluctuations, but a strong second set highlighted by Candyman and a solid Rider‑High Time stretch.
ai_review.review: The two reviews paint a picture of an intriguing May ’70 show that fills a chronological gap. While the SBD source is praised as “ripping” by one listener, the other notes speed wobble, pitch‑correction needs and occasional out‑of‑tune guitars, making the recording quality only fair. Musically the set delivers several gems – a sparse Candyman, an energetic Rider→High Time, a decent first Attics of My Life, a nice Jerry slide on Speedway and a welcomed St. Stephen – though some numbers (Me & My Uncle, Attics) feel merely average.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates the show 5 stars for its excitement, another gives a balanced 3‑star assessment citing technical flaws; averaging these and weighting musical performance higher yields a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Speed fluctuations throughout, multiple pitch‑correction issues (−1% to +1%), occasional tape wow at ~2:07, guitars noticeably out of tune on several songs, and a reel‑change cut in Schoolgirl.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is short (five songs) and technically uneven, while the second set stretches to 17 tracks with an NRPS interlude; overall performance is average‑to‑above‑average but never reaches a true lift‑off.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Nice slide at the end of Speedway, though guitars were noticeably out of tune in places.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey does not play on the acoustic set (alternating with Billy); otherwise drums are present.
